title: Report what the parity root-journal watcher saw when its barrier times out
outcome: A parity calibration timeout reports bounded watcher observations for diagnosis
acceptance: When a root-journal waitFor in scripts/root-probe-harness.mjs times out, its error carries bounded diagnostics: the most recent watcher callbacks (at most 16, with event type and filename), watcher errors and omissions, the expected barrier name and its directory's realpath, and watch/write/wait timings
The 5000 ms budget, every parity assertion and journal cleanup are unchanged; the diagnostics are emitted only on the timeout path and a run where the barrier is seen prints nothing new

Regression tests in the root-journal suite cover a timed-out wait with unmatched callbacks, preexisting watcher errors or null filenames, and a successful barrier without diagnostics, and pass on Windows and macOS

completion.summary: A parity root-journal timeout now reports bounded watcher observations (last 16 callbacks, errors, barrier name/realpath, timings) only on the timeout path; budgets, assertions and cleanup unchanged; root-journal regressions pass on Windows and macOS. Landed diagnostics-only at 42118223 (Windows full gate test-2909383a PASS on the exact tree), installed build 57c858a5.
